name: Ada Marsh
description: Grey shawl, the same jet brooch every time. Takes the chair by the stove without asking.

visits.greeting: Good morning, dear. Lovely and quiet in here.

readThoughts.default: Banked coals. The cat asleep on the hearth.

purpose.2: The coals, dear. They won't keep through the night without it, and the cat complains.

source.2: The curator before you put it in my hands. I've never needed another.

lent.line: Thank you, dear. Same time next week.

alternative.line: Something new? Well. I'll give it a go.
